description: This file defines a React component 'WorkflowTimeline' that displays a timeline view of workflow nodes, fetches and displays associated notes, and provides filtering, sorting, and expand/collapse controls.

methods.name: fetchNotesForNodes
methods.description: Fetches execution notes for each node asynchronously, updates state with notes and tags.

methods.name: handleTagsChange
methods.description: Handles updates to tag filters, invoking callback to parent.

methods.name: handleTagClick
methods.description: Adds a tag to the filter list when a tag badge is clicked.

methods.name: handleSortToggle
methods.description: Toggles sort order between ascending and descending.

methods.name: handleExpandAllToggle
methods.description: Toggles expand/collapse state for all notes.

methods.name: handleNodeClick
methods.description: Handles node selection when a node is clicked.
